title: The future of AI and machine learning (Web Summit LIS26 session page)
what_it_says: Web Summit's session page: 'The future of AI and machine learning', November 11, 2026, 11:00 to 12:00 (Lisbon time), Stage 6, track Startup Showcase. Description: Over the course of an hour, startups explore the practical applications of AI and machine learning. Delve into real-world cases and gain insights into how these technologies are solving complex problems across diverse fields.
